notes.gamma: 1.0: undiscounted success rate and undiscounted sum of D_coll.
notes.normaliser: T_max * D_max = 200 * 400 = 80,000 ms; both read from configs/default.json.
notes.reward: r_t = lambda_Q * 1[success terminal] - lambda_D * D_coll_t / (T_max * D_max).
notes.sac_eta: H_target(s) = eta * log(K_feasible(s)); eta = 0.5 to be validated in P0.
notes.removed: No D_ref, no navigation-progress reward, no terminal bonus, no failure penalty.
notes.weights: lambda_quality=1.0, lambda_latency=0.5 chosen by the Stage 17-D-P0 review.
